lines.text: The LORD tells Moses a jealous husband with no proof must bring his wife and a barley flour offering to the priest.
The priest has the woman stand before the LORD, lets down her hair, and puts the grain offering in her hands.
The priest puts holy water in a clay jar and adds blood to it.
The woman says Amen, Amen, and the priest writes the curses on a scroll and burns it.

wrong_details.true: wash them off into the bitter water
